turns.text: Point is a local-first terminal AI workspace.
The frontend is Go and Bubble Tea; the backend is Python, talking JSON-lines over stdin/stdout.
Nothing about that boundary is incidental --
it is what lets the backend run headless under a test script exactly as it runs under the real TUI.
Here is the shape of one send, end to end:

```python
session = create_session(provider="demo")
send(session, "tell me about this project")
# streams TextDelta events, then one terminal TaskDone
```
Everything you are watching right now -- the pacing, the queueing, the ability to cancel --
is the real streaming and scheduling machinery. Only the words are scripted.
